# Calculator Soup

> > Calculator Soup provides free online calculators for math, finance, conversions, geometry, trigonometry, statistics, and health calculations with step-by-step solutions.

Created by Edward Furey and operated by CalculatorSoup, LLC, this comprehensive calculator resource offers tools ranging from basic arithmetic to complex financial modeling. The site emphasizes educational value by showing detailed work and explanations for each calculation, following standards from NIST and other authoritative sources.

## Key Topics

- math calculators
- financial calculators
- unit conversion
- temperature conversion (Fahrenheit, Kelvin)
- ratio simplification
- fraction conversion
- GCF reduction
- scientific notation and E notation
- wage and salary calculations
- mixed numbers and lowest terms
- trigonometric functions
- Roman numeral conversion
- compound interest
- geometry calculations
- NIST measurement standards

## Financial Calculators

- [Hourly to Salary Calculator – Convert Hourly Pay to Annual Income](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/hourly-to-salary-calculator.php): Converts hourly wage to annual salary with overtime calculations
- [Profit Margin Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/profit-margin-calculator.php): Calculates profit margin and net profit from cost and revenue data
- [Simple Loan Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/loan-calculator-simple.php): Calculates monthly loan payments and generates amortization schedules
- [Future Value Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/future-value-calculator.php): Calculates future value with compound interest and periodic payments
- [Property Tax Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/property-tax-calculator.php): Calculates property taxes with California annual assessment increases

## Math Calculators

- [Ratio Simplifier](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/ratio-simplifier.php): Simplifies ratios to lowest terms using GCF with step-by-step solutions
- [Mixed Number to Percent Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/mixed-number-to-percent-calculator.php): Converts mixed numbers to percentages via improper fractions and decimals
- [Long Division Calculator with Decimals](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/longdivisiondecimals.php): Performs long division with decimals showing step-by-step work
- [Multiplication Tables Practice | Times Tables 1-12](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/multiplicationtables.php): Interactive practice tool for multiplication tables 1-12 with quizzes
- [Odd Permutations Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/discretemathematics/oddpermutations.php): Finds odd permutations using n!/2 for discrete mathematics problems

## Unit Conversion Calculators

- [Fahrenheit to Kelvin | °F to K](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/conversions/fahrenheit-to-kelvin.php): Converts Fahrenheit to Kelvin temperature scale with formula explanation
- [Kelvin to Fahrenheit | K to °F](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/conversions/kelvin-to-fahrenheit.php): Converts Kelvin to Fahrenheit temperature with conversion formula
- [Troy Weight Conversion Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/conversions/weighttroy.php): Converts troy weight units for precious metals (grains, carats, ounces)
- [Roman Numeral Date Converter](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/conversions/roman-numeral-date-converter.php): Converts dates to Roman numerals for tattoos, jewelry, and documents

## Trigonometry & Geometry Calculators

- [Trigonometric Functions Calculator ƒ(x)](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/trigonometry/trigonometricfunctions.php): Calculates sine, cosine, tangent and other trig functions in degrees/radians
- [Stadium Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/geometry-plane/stadium.php): Calculates stadium shape area, perimeter, and radii from known variables

## Time & Health Calculators

- [Age Calculator | Time Duration in Years](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/time/age-calculator.php): Calculates chronological age from date of birth in years, months, days
- [Target Heart Rate Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/health/target-heart-rate-zone-calculator.php): Calculates exercise heart rate zones using Karvonen and basic formulas
